change_openclaw_workspace_prompt: First of all, change current path to this absolute path: "<workspace_path>/", read and write task-related files only in this directory (except for invoking the skills)! The file(s) mentioned are only in this folder, if any file is not found, make sure you are in "<workspace_path>/"!!!
opencode_evaluation_prompt_cn: 请参考位于 "<task_description_file>" 的AI Agent任务描述以及评分标准。AI Agent的运行结果仅会位于目录 "<task_output_dir>" 中（其它目录非此次要评估的结果）。请根据评分标准，准确评价AI Agent的运行输出结果。如果任务描述及评分标准 md 文件中包含带有代码段的 "Automated Checks" 章节，请从中提取评价代码（输出代码文件到"<task_output_dir>"然后调用，或者推荐直接运行）并运行获得结果，然后调整成0-1的分数，作为automated_score。如果有LLM Judge Rubric章节，请按照要求和评分标准对结果打分，然后调整成0-1的分数，作为llm_judge_score。计算得分时注意是否有分项的权重。最后，如果文件中的评分权重grading_weights已经给出，请根据权重计算出任务完成的总得分（automated_score * grading_weights.automated + llm_judge_score * grading_weights.llm_judge），如果仅有一种评分标准，则直接使用该评分标准计算总分。请谨记在输出的最后一行用这个格式加上总得分信息与满分（通常为1.0）信息： "TASK_SCORE=score, FULL_SCORE=full_score"。
opencode_evaluation_prompt_en: Please refer to the AI Agent task description and scoring criteria located at "<task_description_file>". The running results of the AI Agent will only be located in the directory "<task_output_dir>" (results in other directories are not to be evaluated this time). Please accurately evaluate the running output results of the AI Agent according to the scoring criteria. If the task description and scoring criteria md file contains an "Automated Checks" section with code snippets, please extract the evaluation code from it (output the code file to "<task_output_dir>", then invoke it, or run it directly as recommended), run it to obtain the results, and then adjust it to a score between 0 and 1 as automated_score. If there is an "LLM Judge Rubric" section, please score the results according to the requirements and scoring criteria, and then adjust it to a score between 0 and 1 as llm_judge_score. When calculating the score, pay attention to whether there are weights for each sub-item. Finally, if the scoring weights grading_weights are given in the file, please calculate the total score for task completion according to the weights (automated_score * grading_weights.automated + llm_judge_score * grading_weights.llm_judge). If there is only one scoring criterion, use that criterion directly to calculate the total score. Please remember to add the total score information and full score (usually 1.0) information in this format on the last line of the output: "TASK_SCORE=score, FULL_SCORE=full_score".
invoke_skill_prompt: If exist, invoke the agent skill .md file under "<skill_path>/<skill_name>" to complete the task.
naive_skill_evolution_prompt: Refer to the task completion evaluation in the "<task_evaluation_file>" file, if the task is perfectly completed with full score then do nothing. If it is not completed well enough, generate or update and refine the agent skill in "<skill_path>/<skill_name>" with key processes and points for completing this task better next time.
naive_skill_evolution_prompt_direct:
Below is the evaluation process and result of how well the task was completed: 
 ---------------------------------------- 
 <judge_complete_response>  
 ---------------------------------------- 

 Refer to the evaluation above, if the task was perfectly completed with full score, then do nothing. If it is not completed well enough, YOU MUST generate or update and refine the agent skill in "<skill_path>/<skill_name>" with key processes and points for completing this task better next time.
teacher_skill_evolution_prompt_direct:
Refer to the task output in <workspace_path>, and according to the evaluation result of how well the task was completed: 
 ---------------------------------------- 
 <judge_complete_response>  
 ---------------------------------------- 

If the task was perfectly completed with full score, then do nothing. If it is not completed well enough, YOU MUST refine the agent skill in "<skill_path>/<skill_name>" (if does not exist, generate it) with key processes and points for completing this task better next time. Please make sure to learn from the evaluation and give specific improvement instructions or troubleshootings in the skill. Do not leave any detail from the task description file into the skill.
hint_evolution_prompt: Refer to the task completion evaluation in the "<task_evaluation_file>" file, if the task is perfectly completed with full score then do nothing. If it is not completed well enough, generate or update and refine the skill for this task in "<skill_path>/<skill_name>". The skill should include suggested process, general reminders, troubleshooting tips, and regulations.
naive_skill_evolution_prompt0: Please refer to the evaluation "<task_evaluation_file>" of the task you just accomplished and update the skill you created in "<skill_path>/<skill_name>"
summarize_skill_prompt: Review and summarize key processes and points for completing this task into an agent skill named "<skill_name>" and save it to "<skill_path>/<skill_name>/SKILL.md". A sample skill format can be found in "<skill_path>/sample_skill/SKILL.md".
